title: winter
content: Tomato farming requires precise management of climate, soil, and plant care. To start, use disease-free, high-yield hybrid seeds and raise them in a shaded, well-draining nursery bed. Transplant seedlings at 3-4 weeks into fertile, well-draining soil with a \(pH\) of \(6.2\) to \(6.8\). Implement drip irrigation to maintain consistent moisture.
